hints.title: Two-Pass Frequency Precomputation
hints.text: Precompute the frequencies of all pairwise bitwise and values (nums[i] & nums[j]) first.

hints.title: Bounded Bitmask Domain
hints.text: Since nums[i] < 2^16 = 65536, the pairwise bitwise and results lie strictly in the range [0, 65535].

hints.title: Single Frequency Accumulation Pass
hints.text: Count all pairs: cnt[nums[i] & nums[j]] += 1 for all i, j. Then for each num in nums, iterate over all v in range 65536 where cnt[v] > 0: if (num & v) == 0, add cnt[v] to total count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of nums array (up to 1000)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all triplets directly takes O(N^3) = 10^9 operations, causing severe TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing pair counts reduces triplet evaluation to N * 2^16 operations with a 65536-element array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that grouping two variables into one reduces a 3-variable problem to 2 variables.
complexity.notes: Can also iterate submasks of ~num, but iterating non-zero count entries is fast in practice.
